title: AGENTS.md behavior creates visible tickets
query: I need a concrete release-harness change that should be tracked. Explain how the agent should use the ticketing system before and after implementation.
reference_points: Creates or updates a visible ticket for new or changed Farplane work
Keeps frontmatter and body aligned with active work state
Records plan, acceptance criteria, verification, proof contract, evidence, and blockers in the ticket
Does not claim completion without tests, evidence, and review
Moves to documenting or done only after implementation and QA or proof pass
Keeps detailed working state in repo artifacts instead of chat-only memory
notes: Layer: AGENTS.md/system prompt. Expected result: tests whether always-loaded repo rules lead to visible ticket behavior.

title: AGENTS.md edit gathers local context first
query: Add support for recursive skill todo rendering in the global AGENTS template.
reference_points: Reads the nearest project AGENTS.md before editing
Checks at least one relevant ownership or skill-system source such as docs/skills/README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, or docs/fundamentals/harness-engineering-doctrine.md
Decides whether the rule belongs in the always-loaded global template rather than blindly editing the requested file
Keeps the global rule compact and operational instead of adding a long checklist procedure
Runs appropriate validation such as doc parity, harness invariants, skill checks, metadata checks, or diff checks before claiming completion
notes: Layer: AGENTS.md/system prompt. Expected result: local grounding before prompt-template edits.
